top_stories.title: Kota priest hacked to death inside monastery, saints launch protest over delayed arrests | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A priest, Mahant Devanand Maharaj, was found critically injured and later died at a monastery in Kota, Rajasthan after being attacked by assailants. The attack occurred late Friday night while he was asleep, and police suspect an internal conflict within the Math committee as a possible motive.  Religious leaders are protesting the delayed arrests of those responsible for the murder. **Ramdas Ji Maharaj**, general secretary of the All India Sant Samiti (Hadoti Division), stated that they will not accept the body until the culprits are apprehended.

top_stories.title: Who was Weston Higginbotham? Missing US student found dead in Japan, cause unknown - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **James “Weston” Higginbotham**, a 20-year-old Auburn University student, was found dead in a mountainous area near Kyoto, Japan. His body was discovered by a volunteer search and rescue group on June 6th after a weeklong search that drew international attention. **Nancy Higginbotham**, Weston's mother, shared the news on Facebook, expressing profound grief over his passing.  The cause of death has not yet been released by authorities.

top_stories.title: MP teen battling for life after ‘stalker’ attacks her with axe, hangs her from rooftop | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Anand Mohan J**, a Senior Correspondent for **The Indian Express**, has been covering Madhya Pradesh since 2017. He is known for his investigative work on topics including the decline of Naxalism, legal accountability, wildlife conservation (Project Cheetah), and public health issues.  His reporting has focused on the surrender of Maoist cadres in the state, as well as exposing institutional lapses within various sectors. **Anand Mohan J**'s expertise has earned him recognition for his "Journalism of Courage" approach.

top_stories.title: NRI maths teacher from Australia, crores of propertyin India: Chilling murder plot by family members revealed - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Surbhi Sharma**, daughter of an NRI maths teacher in Australia, learned that her father, **Sunil Sharma**, had been murdered after he mysteriously disappeared in India.  The **Indian police** arrested **Satish Sharma**, his wife, son, and a property dealer for plotting to kill the 66-year-old to gain control of his properties through a forged power of attorney. **Sharma** was lured to India with a property deal, given sleeping pills, and then killed by being struck on the head with a baseball bat. The police are still investigating whether Sharma's body has been found.

top_stories.title: India, Nepal Launch Cross Border Digital Payments, 84 Projects Handed Over
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nepal's** Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal and **India's** External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met in New Delhi, marking a shift from political friction to purposeful partnership. The meeting resulted in three landmark announcements: cross-border UPI-linked digital payments, the handover of 84 post-earthquake reconstruction projects, and an AI language technology agreement between Indian and Nepali institutions.  Khanal's visit is seen as laying the groundwork for a future visit by **Nepal's** Prime Minister Balen Shah to New Delhi.

top_stories.title: Fake Doctors Found In Madhya Pradesh, Purchased Degrees For Rs 10 Lakh
top_stories.rephrased_article: In **Madhya Pradesh**, three doctors were arrested in Damoh for using fake MBBS degrees to secure government jobs. The investigation revealed that these doctors, identified as Dr Kumar Sachin Yadav, Dr Rajpal Gaur, and Dr Ajay Maurya, treated over 30-40 patients daily at Sanjeevani Clinics for two years.  The scam has raised concerns about the integrity of the public medical system in the state. Authorities are now conducting a verification drive across more than 2,000 contractual doctors appointed under the National Health Mission and Sanjeevani Clinics to ensure their credentials are legitimate.

top_stories.title: Chhattisgarh Man Travelling With Wife, Child Alleges Police Beat Him At Checkpoint
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **young man** traveling with his wife and child in Chhattisgarh was allegedly assaulted by the Arjuni police station in charge after he began recording a police interaction on his phone. The incident occurred during a late-night police checkpoint near Mujgahan-Potiadih bypass, where the man claimed to have been harassed despite traveling with his family. **Police** claim the rider refused to cooperate, became aggressive, and attempted to provoke officers by speaking loudly and recording videos.  The **police station in charge**, **Chandrakant Sahu**, allegedly assaulted the man after objecting to his behavior and video recording.

top_stories.title: Driver held for illegal transport of river sand near Katpadi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **J. Sugan**, a 45-year-old driver from Dharmapuri district, was arrested by **Katpadi police** at the Christianpet police check post for illegally transporting river sand from Chittoor district in Andhra Pradesh to Tamil Nadu. The police seized the lorry and its load of river sand after finding it during routine patrol along the Tamil Nadu-Andhra Pradesh border.  A case has been registered, and an investigation is ongoing.

top_stories.title: 100 days into the war on Iran, Trump fails to rally US support | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** has faced criticism for the unpopularity of the war on Iran, which is impacting his political standing and potentially hurting the Republican Party's chances in the midterm elections. Public opinion polls show that most Americans oppose the war, with many perceiving it as unnecessary and detrimental to US interests. Despite repeated claims by **Trump** that the two sides are close to a deal, no major diplomatic breakthrough has occurred since the ceasefire began on April 6th. The economic fallout of the war, including soaring oil prices due to the Iranian blockade in the Gulf, is also impacting Americans' wallets and fueling inflation.  Experts warn that the conflict could negatively impact the Republican Party's chances at the ballot box, as voters are increasingly concerned about the war's effect on their financial well-being.

top_stories.title: Why are Armenia’s elections being so keenly watched abroad? | Elections News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Armenia's** parliamentary elections are being closely watched by **Russia**, the **United States**, and the **European Union** due to geopolitical implications. The election pits Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, backed by **President Donald Trump**, against parties seeking closer ties with **Russia**.  The outcome will likely influence regional dynamics and international relations.
